d: We are seeking technically skilled and detail-oriented professionals for the positions of HVAC Engineer / MEP Engineer. These roles focus on building services engineering, mechanical system design, heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC), electrical and plumbing systems, and the development of efficient building infrastructure solutions. The ideal candidates should demonstrate strong engineering knowledge, technical problem-solving abilities, and an understanding of building systems, energy efficiency, and engineering standards.

Responsibilities include designing, reviewing, and coordinating HVAC and MEP systems for commercial, residential, and industrial buildings. Professionals will prepare engineering drawings, technical specifications, equipment schedules, calculations, and system layouts while ensuring compliance with applicable building codes and safety requirements. Additional duties include evaluating mechanical and electrical installations, coordinating with architects, contractors, and other engineering disciplines, conducting site inspections, monitoring installation progress, and troubleshooting technical issues. They will also assess system performance, recommend energy-efficient solutions, review equipment specifications, support testing and commissioning activities, and maintain technical documentation throughout project development and execution.
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of HVAC systems, MEP design principles, and building services engineering.
Knowledge of ventilation, air conditioning, cooling systems, electrical distribution, and plumbing installations.
Familiarity with engineering drawings, technical specifications, and design calculations.
Understanding of building codes, safety regulations, and relevant engineering standards.
Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit MEP, or other engineering design software.
Ability to evaluate system performance and identify technical issues.
Strong analytical, mathematical, and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication, coordination, and technical documentation skills.
Commitment to engineering quality, energy efficiency, safety, and continuous improvement.

To manage and streamline the Request for Information (RFI) process for our correspondent banking network. This role serves as the critical bridge between SGB and our global banking partners, ensuring that all bilateral inquiries, compliance questionnaires, and due diligence requests are handled accurately, comprehensively, and efficiently. The ideal candidate brings deep subject matter expertise in correspondent banking operations, Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations, and compliance frameworks.
q: li
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
li
Professional certifications such as CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist) or CGSS (Certified Global Sanctions Specialist) are highly desirable.
li
Minimum of 4–7 years of experience in banking or financial services, with at least 3 years specifically focused on correspondent banking, RFI management, or FIG compliance.
li
Proven track record in completing, interpreting, and managing the Wolfsberg Group Correspondent Banking Due Diligence Questionnaires (CBDDQ) and other standard industry compliance inquiries.
li
Deep operational knowledge of AML, CTF, KYC, and Sanctions compliance principles as they apply to cross-border payments and correspondent banking.
li
Demonstrated experience in networking, managing relationships, and clarifying complex requests with relationship managers at partner banks and internal stakeholders.
li
Strong analytical capability with the proven ability to synthesise complex regulatory policies and internal guidelines into clear, professional external communications.
li
Highly organised project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple, time-sensitive RFI deadlines simultaneously without compromising accuracy.
li
Proficiency with standard banking compliance screening tools, KYC/KYB file management, and database repository maintenance.
li

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, adept at tailoring complex compliance narratives for external institutional partners while maintaining an unwavering commitment to the bank's regulatory standards.
r: Serve as the primary point of contact within FIG for all incoming RFIs and compliance questionnaires from correspondent banks and financial institutions.
Work with Compliance to review and maintain SGB's Wolfsberg Group Correspondent Banking Due Diligence Questionnaires (CBDDQ).

Draft, review, and assemble comprehensive response packages to RFIs and compliance queries. Proactively manage the periodic refresh cycle for correspondent banking KYC/KYB files, ensuring zero disruption to SGB’s active nostro accounts.
Maintain a centralised, up-to-date repository of standard RFI responses, institutional documentation, and compliance policies to accelerate turnaround times.
Review and interpret complex compliance inquiries from partner banks, collaborating with SGB’s central AML/Compliance teams to formulate accurate and risk-appropriate responses.
Identify potential compliance risks or gaps highlighted during the RFI process and escalate these to senior FIG management and the Chief Compliance Officer.
Liaise directly with relationship managers at partner banks to clarify ambiguous RFI requests and negotiate realistic submission deadlines.
Partner cross-functionally with internal stakeholders—including Legal, Risk, Operations, and Compliance—to gather specialised data required for complex RFI submissions.
Represent the FIG team in compliance-focused meetings, audits, and calls with correspondent banks.
